stock-weakness-analyzer-sneak-restore.head: 4d022c93427e1f04434d5b4e581de1fd85ac8d22
stock-weakness-analyzer-sneak-restore.scope: The native Weakness Analyzer shortcut sent stock 1125. PacketLog 1617–1699 verifies 25 IS, a four-second cast and own reuse of 45 seconds. The 8-second target record and 1.5-second caster record end independently, and Sneak resumes after the caster record ends.

area.source: GOB 38 defines an eight-metre hostile area centred on the caster.
area.runtime: CasterHostileArea enumerates eligible hostile recipients at completion and gives each candidate its own viral contest.
area.test: AreaDisruptionTests.CasterEightMetreBoundaryIgnoresSelectionAndKeepsZeroDamage checks inside, edge, outside and different-floor cases. PR556 compares QAFar at six metres, the defended QAFriend and the immune QAEnemy during the same cast. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/556

controls.source: GOB 47 grants 6 s Pacify, breaks on damage and applies a separate 12 s immunity timer.
controls.runtime: Freeze Area supplies Pacify and the vulnerability through the same parent. Damage clears both together. Dropping the parent preserves the independent immunity.
controls.test: FreezePacifyEndsOnDamageWhileKeepingTwelveSecondImmunity and the PR556 stock retry confirm initial Pacify, early parent removals on damage, refusal of the later Stun and immunity expiry. PacketLog 4757–4760, 5117–5121 and 6066. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/556

script.source: GOB 47 calls AddControlImmunityTimer when its Pacify lands.
script.runtime: TimedEffects registers 734→681 independently of the Freeze Area parent and admits the next control only after expiry.
script.test: PR556 stock records the 12 s immunity with both selected targets. The elapsed run permits Stun after its expiry and the early retry refuses Stun while it is active. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/556
